title: Autopay Customers: Added Installments on an Additional Business Security Deposit
content:
Autopay lengthens the installment plan of an additional amount owed on a business Security Deposit.

**Rule.** Where at least 6 of the secured Electric Service Agreement's payments posted in the 6 months ending on the payment date came through autopay, 2 installments are added; where at least 3 but fewer than 6 did, 1 is added; otherwise none is added.

| Payments through autopay in the 6 months ending on the payment date | Installments added |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2 |
| 3 to 5 | 1 |
| 0 to 2 | None |

Only payments on the secured agreement whose payment channel is autopay are counted.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts)

- 6 autopay payments: 2 added; 5 autopay payments: 1 added.
- 3 autopay payments: 1 added; 2 autopay payments: none added.
